hints.INTRO_SPELL: Introduce yourself using the keywords on the card (name, age, country, residence, languages, job, hobby).
hints.SPELL_WORD: Spell the word the examiner asks for (buchstabieren).
hints.READ_NUMBER: Read out the number/phone/postcode the examiner asks for.
hints.INTRO_CARD: Introduce yourself using the keywords on the card — speak in full sentences.
hints.ASK_PERSON: Ask your partner ONE question about the keyword on the card (e.g. Geburtstag? → Wann hast du Geburtstag?).
hints.ASK_QWORD: Ask ONE question about the topic, starting with the question word on the card.
hints.ASK_REQUEST: Look at the picture and make a request (Bitte) to your partner.
hints.ASK_CARD: Ask your partner ONE question about the word on the card.
hints.REACT_REQUEST: React to your partner's request (accept or decline politely).
hints.ANSWER_PARTNER: Answer the question your partner just asked (their card is shown here).
hints.PRESENT_LONG: Present your topic (introduction – content – conclusion). Speak fluently for 3–4 minutes; use your notes if needed.
hints.PRESENT_SHORT: Present/narrate your topic. Speak fluently with an introduction, content and a conclusion.
hints.ANSWER_PARTNER_PRESENTATION: Answer your partner's question about your presentation.
hints.ANSWER_QUESTION: Answer the question you were just asked.
hints.CONTACT_THEN_PRUEFER: Respond to your partner; then the examiner will ask one more question.
hints.OPEN_CALENDAR: Start: suggest a free day/time from YOUR calendar (your partner's calendar is different).
hints.OPEN_VORLAGE: Tell your partner what YOUR text (Vorlage) says (topic, key figures).
hints.OPEN_CONTACT: Start: greet, introduce yourself and ask your partner about a topic on the card.
hints.OPEN_DEBATE: Start: state your position on the question clearly with one main reason.
hints.OPEN_DEFAULT: Start: make the first suggestion / state your view.
hints.CLOSE_CALENDAR: Wrap up: repeat the date and time you agreed on.
hints.CLOSE_DEBATE: Conclude: summarise both sides, then say clearly whether you are for or against.
hints.CLOSE_DEFAULT: Conclude: summarise what you both agreed on.
hints.REACT_CALENDAR: Respond: agree if you are free; otherwise decline with a reason and suggest another time.
hints.REACT_VORLAGE: Respond to your partner's text; talk about your own experience/opinion and ask back.
hints.OPEN_MEINUNG: Phase 1 — report: BRIEFLY relay the opinion on your card — who the person is (name, age, job) and what they think. Don't read it out word for word.
hints.AGREE_AND_ADD: Phase 3 — respond: pick up what your partner just said — agree AND add a point or experience of your own, or disagree with a reason. No need to argue; ask one question back.
hints.REACT_CONTACT: Answer, then ask your partner about another topic on the card.
hints.REACT_DEBATE: Counter the argument you just heard (concede a point, then argue the other way).
hints.REACT_DEFAULT: Respond to your partner: agree/disagree with a reason, then suggest the next point.
hints.FEEDBACK_COMMENT: Give your partner one comment on the presentation (what was good/new/interesting) and ask ONE question.
hints.ANSWER_PRUEFER_TOPIC: Answer the examiner's question about the topic.

LESEN.t1: Read all options first and sum each up in 2–3 words.
LESEN.t2: Look for the MAIN idea of each text; do not match just because one word repeats.
LESEN.t3: Do the items you are sure about first, the hard ones last.

SPRACHBAUSTEINE.t1: Look at the words right before and after the gap to see which word class is needed.
SPRACHBAUSTEINE.t2: Fill the certain gaps first; the remaining options narrow down.
SPRACHBAUSTEINE.t3: The finite verb is in position 2; subordinate clauses (weil, dass, falls) send it to the end.

SCHREIBEN.t1: Write at least one sentence for each point P1–P4; a missing point costs a band in criterion I.
SCHREIBEN.t2: Link sentences with weil, deshalb, außerdem; unlinked sentences cost the A in criterion II.
SCHREIBEN.t3: Open and close the email like a message to a friend, with consistent register.

HOEREN.t1: Use the reading time to underline the key words of each statement before listening.
HOEREN.t2: Statements follow the order of the recording — decide as soon as you hear the point.
HOEREN.t3: Common traps: the speaker says the opposite, or says it about another person or time.

note.p: What you wrote, what to write and why.

criteria.p: Each criterion has bands A–D and how to move up.

steps.p: You take one Teil after another; the clock on the right is the time for the current Teil. It keeps running while you read this; the examiner waits until you finish.

mic.p: A yellow ring means it is your turn. Tap to speak, tap again to stop and send. It is locked while the examiner or your partner is speaking.

task.p: The task, a hint for this step and your draft notes. On a phone, tap the Task card row to open it.

diagnostic.formTitle: About {n} minutes to know what to practise first
diagnostic.formLead: Every part of the real exam: Lesen 1–3, Sprachbausteine 1–2, Hören 1–3, Schreiben and the oral exam, scored to the telc B1 standard (writing and speaking scored by AI). The written exam takes about 150 minutes, the oral exam about 20. Each part is saved separately, so you can stop and spread it over several sessions.
diagnostic.examHint: telc Deutsch B1 is available. Your learning goal will be set to this exam.
diagnostic.dateBad: The exam date must be after today.
diagnostic.dateEmpty: Pick your exam date to build the plan.
diagnostic.startError: Could not start the diagnostic test.
diagnostic.leave: Leave the diagnostic test (finished parts are kept)
diagnostic.shortFormNote: This result comes from the short diagnostic test (part 1 of each section only). Retake it to measure every part of the real exam.
diagnostic.writingPending: The AI has not finished grading the letter. Submit again in a few minutes.
diagnostic.oralTitle: Oral exam with an AI examiner
diagnostic.oralBody: The three telc B1 speaking parts, scored on the telc criteria. About 20 minutes; a microphone is needed.
diagnostic.oralRule1: Part 1: getting to know each other.
diagnostic.oralRule2: Part 2: talk about a topic and discuss it.
diagnostic.oralCta: Go to the oral exam room
diagnostic.oralBack: When you are done, come back here and tap "Check oral result".
diagnostic.oralNotYet: No scored oral exam found since you started the diagnostic test.
diagnostic.exitBody: Finished parts are kept. The {part} part you are working on is saved as a draft; next time you open the diagnostic test you continue from here.
diagnostic.exitFailed: The draft could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.
